- [other] BElluu: I do not know why, but it's so laggy on my PC in chrome. When I cut some ink or do some chaotic moves it's more than 1000ms Presentation delay
- [author] georgestrakhov: yes, definitely some optimizations are due if you go beyond 20-30 moves or move fast. would love a PR on that if anyone cares!

{"decision": "push", "reason": "这是一个小而具体的浏览器产品：把日本墨流纸（Suminagashi）做成可交互的模拟器，无障碍树里能看到墨色选择、搅动、吹气、梳理、Print 等具体工具。创意新颖、形式精巧，符合她喜欢的有趣小产品。页面文字未能提取，卡顿评论也不足以否定其价值。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason cites the ink colour selection, Blow, Hair-style combing and Print tools from the accessibility tree. It correctly notes that the page text was not extracted and acknowledges the lag comment. "Stirring" is a loose reading of the Drift or Alternate controls, not an invented claim, and the reason argues clearly for push.
